title: Interest Rate Buydown Credit Policy: Buydowns Carried by One Loan File
content:
## Clause

**1.** A loan file may carry only one temporary buydown and only one permanent buydown in elected, approved, funded or completed status.

**2.** A temporary and a permanent Interest Rate Buydown combine on one file only where the temporary product is one that can be combined with a permanent buydown. The permanent points then lower the note rate first, and the temporary reductions apply to the bought-down note rate.

**3.** Seller or builder money for both counts together toward the interested party cap of the loan.

## Basis of the count

The buydowns a loan file carries are read from Larkspur Home Lending's own buydown records for that same loan file, before a buydown is elected on it: the buydowns on that loan file whose status is elected, approved, funded or completed, each with its buydown type (temporary or permanent).

| Status of an existing buydown on the same loan file | Counted toward the one-per-type limit |
|---|---|
| elected | Yes |
| approved | Yes |
| funded | Yes |
| completed | Yes |
| terminated early | No |
| cancelled | No |

## Cases (hypothetical files)

| Already on the loan file | Buydown being elected | Under this clause |
|---|---|---|
| a funded Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown | a Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown | a second temporary buydown; the limit is reached |
| a cancelled Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown | a Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown | the cancelled buydown is not counted; the temporary limit is not reached |
| a completed Larkspur One-Point Permanent Buydown | a Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown | a second permanent buydown; the limit is reached |
| an approved Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown, a product that can be combined with a permanent buydown | a Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown | one of each type; the combination is permitted |
| an approved Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown, a product that cannot be combined with a permanent buydown | a Larkspur One-Point Permanent Buydown | the combination is not permitted |

## Combined buydown in figures (hypothetical)

A loan file carries a permanent buydown that lowers a hypothetical 6.875% note rate by 0.500, and a temporary buydown with a hypothetical loan year 1 reduction of 1.000. The permanent points act first: the bought-down note rate is 6.375%. The temporary reduction then applies to 6.375%, giving a loan year 1 payment rate of 5.375%.

If the seller pays a hypothetical $3,200.00 for the points and $2,453.64 for the temporary subsidy, the seller money counted toward the loan's interested party cap is the two together, $5,653.64.
